title: Fathers Navigating Court-Ordered Programs
description: This course helps fathers understand the purpose of court-ordered programs, what courts look for, and how to engage in a way that demonstrates accountability and genuine behaviour change. It supports fathers to meet requirements safely, respectfully, and consistently.
learningOutcomes: Understand why courts order programs and what they aim to achieve.
Recognise behaviours that demonstrate accountability and progress.
Learn how to communicate respectfully with facilitators and caseworkers.
Develop strategies to complete programs consistently and safely.

modules.title: Why Courts Order Programs
modules.content: Explains safety concerns, risk factors, and the role of mandated intervention.

modules.title: Engaging Safely and Respectfully
modules.content: Covers attendance, participation, emotional regulation, and accountability.

modules.title: Demonstrating Change
modules.content: Provides practical steps for showing progress, insight, and responsibility.
